note: From the original description by Holmgren 1913 (in German). The alate is unknown; the original describes the small soldier and the worker, and a footnote mentions the measurements of the large soldier of the same species. The original in German was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few word forms and figures have recognition errors (e.g. l,i should be 1,1) and have been checked against the context; the measurements are in mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Small soldier: head reddish yellow, the nasus slightly brownish; abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown; the rest of the body rusty yellow to yellowish white. Hairs on the head and abdominal tergites almost invisible (microscopic). Head (without the nasus) perfectly circular in dorsal view; nasus long, conical, pointed at the apex. Frontal outline straight, but with a very weak depression behind the base of the nasus. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head orange, the transverse band paler; body straw yellow. Head sparsely hairy; abdominal tergites with fairly dense short hairs. Head broadly oval; cranial suture visible; fontanelle fairly distinct; anterior part of the transverse band concave; basal piece of the postclypeus fairly short and flatly convex.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Small soldier: body length 3—3.5; head length including nasus 1.90; head length without nasus 0.87; head width 1.01; pronotum width 0.57. Worker: body length 3—3.5; head width 1.14; pronotum width 0.65. Distribution: Borneo, Sarawak (Haviland), Malaya (v. Buttel-Reepen). Note: a footnote in the original records that the collection to be published later by v. Buttel-Reepen contains two soldier grades, the larger one with head length including nasus 2.3—2.2 mm and head width 1.4—1.1 mm.
